sourceFiles: 2026 CONTRACT RATES/KENYA/ACCOMODATION/SANCTUARY FARM RATES/SANCTUARY FARM RATES 2026.docx (2).pdf
currency: Both USD and KES quoted (conversion rate stated as KES1:USD0.0077)
notes: Self-catering cottage/house rentals (whole-unit pricing, NOT per person) - catering not included in the cottage price; a separate Kijiko Restaurant full-board add-on option exists.
Same rates apply to both Residents and Non-Residents (unusual - most other properties in this project differentiate).
Conservancy fee is billed separately, payable at the main gate on arrival.

theMabatiHouse.layout: 2 double/twin bedrooms, kitchen, 1 bathroom, open-plan living/dining (one side opens up entirely)

theRoseCottage.layout: 1 double/twin bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, outdoor chill & fire

theWatchTower.layout: 1 upstairs double bedroom with wraparound windows, kitchen, WC, shower under stars, outdoor deck

sanctuaryFarmhouse.layout: 3 double bedrooms + 1 bedroom with 5 single beds, kitchen, pantry, dining room, living room with fireplace, 3 bathrooms, verandah lounge & dining, lake view

theYellowHouse.layout: 3 double bedrooms, 2 kitchens, dining room, TV room, pantry, laundry, landscaped garden

camping.includes: Bush kitchen and bathrooms, flushing toilets, dish washing station, hot showers

kijikoRestaurant.safetyNote: Do not walk to the restaurant after 18:45 due to roaming hippos - safari car + driver available for KES1,000

policies.bookingBasis: Advance booking only, for accommodation, restaurant, and all activities
policies.deposit: 50% deposit required to secure any booking
policies.cancellation: Moderate policy: full refund up to 7 days before stay, minus 10% processing fee
policies.taxesIncluded: All rates include 18% government taxes and levies
policies.bankCharges: Sender covers all bank transfer charges
